strongest_angle: A CBS News investigation reveals that the Department of Justice holds classified Epstein-related materials that were previously claimed not to exist, contradicting official transparency statements.

key_facts.fact: The Justice Department has released more than 3,000,000 pages of material related to the Jeffrey Epstein investigation.
On March 25, 2025, the FBI New York office delivered 16 items to the Office of the Deputy Attorney General, including two labeled as classified material.
A series of approximately 4,500 images of checks from Jeffrey Epstein's financial records were processed as part of the Epstein Files Transparency Act document release.
